name: @sderickson/recipes-dev
description: Docker compose setup for dev environment

scripts.dev: saf-docker prune && saf-docker build --compose docker-compose.yaml && ./scripts/dev-compose.sh up -V
scripts.up: saf-docker prune && saf-docker build --compose docker-compose.yaml && ./scripts/dev-compose.sh up --detach -V
scripts.down: saf-docker generate && docker compose --env-file env.dev --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yaml down
